story_name: Sekhmet's Restraint: Controlling the Destroyer Within
character_description: Sekhmet, lioness-headed goddess with golden mane radiating fierce power, luminous amber eyes reflecting both predatory intensity and ancient wisdom, bronze skin glowing with contained destructive energy. She embodies power so immense it must be consciously controlled.
setting: Sacred temples where destruction and healing coexist, deserts of purification and transformation
theme: Learning that greatest power requires greatest restraint and that destruction serves creation

video_prompts: Sekhmet manifests as destroying force—her rage consuming all, creating devastation across Egypt.
first_frame_prompt: Sekhmet appears as pure destructive force, golden mane blazing with uncontrolled fire, luminous amber eyes burning with fury. Her bronze skin radiates heat so intense it melts landscape. She destroys not from malice but from unbridled power lacking container. Egypt burns in her wake. The destruction is absolute and terrifying.
speech: I am destroyer. I am fury made manifest. I burn all I touch.

video_prompts: Sekhmet agrees to restraint—learning to hold immense power within conscious container without diminishing it.
first_frame_prompt: Sekhmet sits in meditation, golden mane settling, luminous amber eyes becoming focused. She learns to contain her power—not suppress it but direct it. Bronze skin no longer radiates uncontrolled heat but purposeful fire. She discovers that restraint is not weakness—it is highest expression of strength. Control paradoxically increases power's effectiveness.
speech: Restraint is not diminishment. It is mastery. I choose where and how I burn.
